entry_state: Conditional total variance explains the expected-uncertainty inequalities, which are not statewise or quantile bounds. Under true conditional-mean reserves, development results are martingale differences; future revision variances add under those stated assumptions.
exit_state: Zero covariance does not imply independence, and arbitrary reserve refits need not inherit variance additivity. Cost-of-capital charges require separately chosen capital, rates and payment dates. The software exchange must now retain complete draws and distinguish valid zero from failure.
findings: The revision example has variances 25 and 5 with zero covariance but dependent magnitudes.
The margin formula fixes beginning-year capital and end-year charge timing; stochastic discount and capital need a declared joint expectation.
The source's historical charge and tolerance inputs are not defaults. Unsupported probabilities, preferences or domains block dependent evaluation. No new defect observed.
